exact_blockers: The catalogued label Beam-TasNet / Beam-Guided TasNet covers two distinct architectures: Beam-TasNet combines multichannel Conv-TasNet separation with MVDR, while Beam-Guided TasNet is a separate iterative framework. The pinned research records neither an exact selected implementation nor an immutable source revision, checkpoint digest or weight licence, and no source, checkpoint or runtime for either architecture exists in this worktree.

No rights-cleared synchronized microphone-array corpus with declared geometry, channel calibration, timestamp alignment, reference channel, target/reference directions and clean target images is present. Adjacent offline and online multichannel WPE fixtures are two-channel synthetic dereverberation controls, not array recordings and not beamforming or separation evidence.

No pinned runnable framework or vendor runtime exists in this worktree (no torch, asteroid, speechbrain, onnxruntime or equivalent is installed), so even a caller-supplied checkpoint could not be executed here; nothing was downloaded, installed, loaded or invoked.

No held-out task-matched array scoring, independent scorer, permitted listening result, measured channel synchronization or geometry calibration, target-device timing, benchmark or release artifact exists; therefore no result, including the synthetic fixture diagnostics, may qualify the candidate.
